probertite.identity: NaCaB5O7(OH)4(H2O)3; distinct mineral, not borates commodity, boron element, ulexite or mixed ore. IMA G/1929.
probertite.specimen: Natural Kramer Deposit, Pagano collection 11717. X-ray and neutron arms used separate crystals.
probertite.conditions: X-ray crystal 0.06×0.120×0.260 mm at 293 K; neutron crystal 3.1×1.5×1.5 mm at 20(1) K. Both P21/c; these are characterization temperatures, not processing conditions.
probertite.chemistry: EPMA CaO15.8(2), Na2O8.6(3) wt%; beam damage recognized. Trace Table1 is a separate ten-analysis summary, Li mean0.392±0.091 wt ppm. Not global purity or zero contaminants.
probertite.model: Three tetrahedral and two triangular B sites; four hydroxyls and three waters per formula; ten H sites first found from neutron data and then used for X-ray. No claim of independent rerefinement.
limits: CIFs unavailable and final publisher version not compared to AAM.
Neutron anisotropic displacement/extinction-correction limitations explicitly discussed.
EPMA Sr800–1000 wt ppm and LA mean1230±230 wt ppm are separate analytical summaries, not identical point measurements.

PDF9 says two hydroxyl groups for Ca coordination but lists three O1H1/O10H3/O11H4; stated CaO5(OH)3(OH2) coordination is internally consistent with three. The owner does not repeat that local count typo.
No mechanical, thermal, dissolution, boron recovery, microbial or industrial shielding experiment accepted.

priceite.identity: Ca2B5O7(OH)5(H2O); IMA G/1873; pandermite is historical synonym. Distinct from gowerite/colemanite and elemental or commodity boron.
priceite.specimen2002: Natural Sultancayir, Turkey; South Australian Museum G3769; synchrotron powder diffraction, not a synthetic analogue.
priceite.model2002: P21/c powder refinement; Rwp0.042,Rp0.030. Four tetrahedral and one triangular B sites. B sites geometrically assigned and not refined; H not located, hydroxyl/water assignment by bond valence. No direction selected because abstract [100] and body [001] conflict.
priceite.specimen2017: Separate Fuka natural aggregate/veinlet associated with other calcium borates; not G3769 or a phase-pure synthetic process feed.
priceite.chemistry2017: Eight EPMA analyses: meanB2O3 49.95wt% (range48.96–51.07, SD0.65), CaO32.35wt% (31.46–33.19, SD0.46). H2O17.56wt% calculated by difference because insufficient pure material; density2.486g/cm3 calculated from formula and cell. Not direct water or density measurements.
limits: Formation by shimazakiite alteration and 100–190°C or less is geological interpretation using other synthesis work, not a controlled experiment in this paper.
The 2002 [100]/[001] discrepancy remains unresolved; no machine-readable atomic model acquired in this pass.
Older composition/hydration proposals are historical, not all co-valid modern ideal formulas.
No criticality, microbial extraction or industrial deployment inferred.
